verdict.rationale: Kong ships dedicated MCP capabilities: a documented MCP product page describing traffic governance/security/observability and auto-generation of MCP servers from REST APIs (kong-docs-3, kong-gh-6, kong-gh-16), plus a specifically named 'Konnect MCP' official server endpoint (kong-probe-3) and Konnect features to auto-generate/deploy MCP servers (kong-docs-53, kong-docs-54). This is first-party documentation clearly describing an official MCP server an agent can connect to, not just client-side tool use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification that an agent successfully connects to the Konnect MCP server in practice.
